original_prompt: Create a completely fresh photorealistic full-body studio photograph, using the supplied original close-up ONLY for precise fictional adult woman's face identity, hairstyle, skin appearance and visual style, not as a canvas. Native sharp rendering from scratch; no stretching or retouching previous full-body images. Preserve the exact delicate face identity, fine hair strands, true skin texture, crisp textile weave and soft bright photographic style of the reference. Pose MUST be strictly FRONT-facing, eye-level camera, head perfectly vertical without tilt, turn, chin lift or bow; eyes horizontal, shoulders level, arms naturally at sides, no hip sway. DO NOT imitate reference tilted pose. Approximately 7 to 7.2 heads tall; normal adequately large head, not miniature. Slim elegant healthy proportions, no extreme thinness or exaggerated fashion-illustration legs. One complete person, hair crown through entire shoes visible with comfortable margins on a pure white seamless backdrop, soft even neutral studio light and subtle contact shadow. Vertical 2:3 frame, native detailed PNG, no text, collage, fog, blur, vignette, crop or watermark.  OUTFIT: cream tiny floral zip hoodie over white rib tank, white straight jeans, white canvas sneakers. SPECIFIC REQUIRED ANATOMICAL RESULT: A clearly substantial normal-sized adult head, crown-to-chin is 1/7 of body height EXCLUDING the hair bun. Do not count tall bun as skull length. Head must not look miniature relative to shoulders. Keep balanced legs and torso.
